description: This file provides example drive cycle applications for battery modeling, including functions to create example cells, run drive cycle simulations, and analyze battery behavior under different conditions.

classes.name: slide::DEG_ID
classes.description: Structure representing degradation parameters and states for a battery cell.

classes.name: slide::Cell_SPM
classes.description: Class representing a single-particle model of a battery cell.

classes.name: slide::Cycler
classes.description: Class for running charge/discharge cycles on a battery cell.

classes.name: slide::ThroughputData
classes.description: Data structure for throughput measurements during cycling.

classes.name: slide::State_SPM
classes.description: Class representing the state variables of the single-particle model.

classes.name: slide::Clock
classes.description: Utility class for timing and performance measurement.

methods.name: get_exampleCell
methods.description: Creates and initializes an example battery cell with predefined parameters and prints its voltage, current, and capacity.

methods.name: init_cell_manual
methods.description: Runs a manual charge/discharge cycle on a given cell simulation object, updating capacity, time, and energy throughput.

methods.name: drive_cycle_artemis
methods.description: Performs a simulated drive cycle based on Artemis profile, including cycling, data logging, and analysis of battery voltage, SOC, and surface concentrations.
